preconditions.description: Attacker must have at least some TOFU tokens to initiate a transfer
Contract's totalSupply must be greater than 5000000000e9 (5 billion tokens with 9 decimals)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _transfer function when totalSupply > 5 billion. The function incorrectly deducts the burnFee from the sender's balance twice: once when subtracting newAmount and again when subtracting burnFee. This causes the sender's balance to be reduced by more than the intended amount (amount + burnFee instead of just amount), while the total supply is only reduced by burnFee. The exploit demonstrates this logic error by showing that after a transfer, the sum of all balances exceeds totalSupply. Call transfer() with any amount when totalSupply > 5 billion to trigger the buggy burn logic.
